title: Diene Platform Compiler Values
description: Generated schema for the diene-platform compiler chart (source A defaults + platform.yaml + services.yaml).

apiVersions.description: Frozen T3 / upstream API groups the compiler renders against.

dependencies.description: PlatformDependency modules by class (database/kv/cache/store). Each module carries type + explicit delivery: external|local|replicated.

fleet.description: The fleet git repository (sources A and C live here).

infisical.description: Infisical project wiring for the Platform CR.

kargo.description: Kargo promotion bot identity (fixed git-update promotion template).

landscapes.description: Declared landscape set (canary declares the FULL set).

oci.description: OCI registry that publishes per-service app + primordial charts.

platform.description: Explicit platform name (S16 single source of truth). Must equal the release namespace; the compiler refuses a mismatch.

primordial.description: The Primordial central cluster (g1 primordial-app destination).

profile.description: lapras profile toggle: when true, delivery: local modules render as direct single-cluster Applications; when false (prod) they are stripped.

services.description:
Machine roster: which

. repos exist. One Warehouse + one Kargo stage-chain + one AppSet fan-out is rendered per entry.

stages.description: Pipeline DAG. Each entry is a step: a bare landscape name, an object {landscape, gate: auto|manual, soak, verification:{analysisTemplates}}, or a list of either (a [parallel, set] step). Compiled 1:1 into Kargo Stages.

virtualLandscapeServices.description: VirtualLandscapeService serve fragments (platform-level, canary exercises one).

webhookEngine.description: WebhookEngine config (post-Q-WH1/WH3 shape; NO engine-version field).
